body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 Force Damage and suppress its ordinary concealment against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, move the target 1 unit sideways.
On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Assault
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and hit, you may move 1 unit to mirror the target's new position after its next voluntary movement before your next turn.
